implementation_recommendations.label: Registers
implementation_recommendations.value: Use two qubits and two classical bits.

implementation_recommendations.label: Preparation
implementation_recommendations.value: Apply H to q0, then CX from q0 to q1.

implementation_recommendations.label: Measurement
implementation_recommendations.value: Measure q0 to c0 and q1 to c1.
